long_biography.plain_text:
Jan Kroese trained in construction before entering Dutch commercial property at Jones Lang LaSalle and DTZ Zadelhoff. In 1984 he and Patrick Paternotte established KroesePaternotte, concentrating on prime retail locations. The firm became a national specialist in leasing, acquisitions, valuations and investment advice, serving retailers, owners, developers and public bodies.

At Kroeseinvest, Kroese moved from day-to-day leadership at the brokerage toward an Amsterdam-based property company focused on investment, development and management. Its strategy covers commercial, residential and mixed-use assets, with value created through acquisition, financing, redevelopment, active management and sale. The company also holds stakes in selected ventures outside its core property portfolio.
long_biography.html:
Jan Kroese trained in construction before entering Dutch commercial property at Jones Lang LaSalle and DTZ Zadelhoff. In 1984 he and Patrick Paternotte established KroesePaternotte, concentrating on prime retail locations. The firm became a national specialist in leasing, acquisitions, valuations and investment advice, serving retailers, owners, developers and public bodies.

At Kroeseinvest, Kroese moved from day-to-day leadership at the brokerage toward an Amsterdam-based property company focused on investment, development and management. Its strategy covers commercial, residential and mixed-use assets, with value created through acquisition, financing, redevelopment, active management and sale. The company also holds stakes in selected ventures outside its core property portfolio.
